naturalistic_2026-10-10.line_thinning: scripts/pack_wildlife.py thin_lines(): strokes darker than luminance 0.42 that vanish under a 5-iteration opening are eroded by 1px per side at 2K; shaved pixels take the nearest opaque non-line colour; remaining strokes blend 35% toward warm brown (96,62,40). Broad dark areas (tail tufts, ear backs, mouths) are untouched. A 2px shave broke silhouettes.
